notes:
Current status: deal stalled in procurement due to unit economics not meeting Skylark's target NPU (net present unit) per patient query. They ran Redwood Dedicated pricing vs. competitor quotes and an in-house GPU amortization. Key excerpts below.

- Summary of objection: 'We like the platform — latency was good, console & observability strong. But our CFO says per-patient inference cost is ~0.045 USD with Redwood (est.), target is 0.02–0.03 USD. Need 40–55% reduction to justify replacing current on-prem cluster.'

- Cost specifics from their model: avg 512 tokens -> Redwood hosted/dedicated effective per-request token cost approx $0.011/token (our quote v2). For their workload (50M queries/year) the projected annual cost puts ARR above $400k at current commit sizes; finance flagged as not feasible under current budget.

- Competitor angle: one vendor (unnamed) proposed bring-your-own-GPU + lower management fee (approx 30% lower TCO for Skylark's config). They also received an internal feasibility note: build vs. buy — 'build' with existing GPUs looks cheaper until labor & ops factored. Skylark prioritized predictability but needs price parity.

- Security & compliance: Security team is satisfied with SOC2 answers, KMS plan, and VPC options. This was NOT the blocker — pricing is. Quote: 'Security OK; we can sign.'

- Internal champion: Dir. ML (lead sponsor) left in January; new interim sponsor is VP Eng but less focused on cost transformation. No clear exec champion to push budget increase.

- Engagement notes: multiple outreach attempts since 2025-02-05 (calls + email). Response rate dropped after finance workshop. Stakeholders are politely unresponsive on pricing counterproposal.

- Technical notes from POC: latency stable @ 120–160ms p95 for triage model; embeddings quality acceptable; autoscaling behavior validated on Dedicated. POC metrics attached in drive:/deals/skylark/poc-metrics.csv.

- What we tried: 1) Presented Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) projecting 20–30% cost reduction; 2) Revised committed capacity proposal (smaller baseline + burst credits); 3) Offered 6-mo discounted onboarding fee. None achieved finance threshold.

- Direct quote from CFO on 2025-01-22 call: 'We need unit economics that don't increase per-patient cost. If we move to Redwood it must reduce our total cost of ownership within 12 months.'

- Next steps attempted: Aisha submitted an internal price exception request (deal desk) on 2025-02-07 to test lower per-token bands; asked Skylark for 1-week window for final decision (no reply).

- Suggested playbook if resurrecting: 1) new cost model with BYOC option + transparent GPU amortization; 2) a 6–9 month money-back style runway guarantee tied to measurable token cost reductions; 3) re-engage with VP Eng + new Dir. ML hire once in place.

- Status label for SDR/renewal: stalled -> closed at present (finance freeze). Mark as high probability to re-open in 6–12 months if budget cycle shifts or new exec champion appears.

- Links: proposal v2 (drive:/deals/skylark/proposal-v2.pdf), security FAQ (drive:/security/summaries/skylark-sec-responses.docx).

- Sales notes (shorthand): leave cadence at monthly; skip weekly until CFO re-opens. Capture any competitor POPs. If they ask again, propose a BYO-GPU pilot to match competitor TCO and upsell Optimize for quantization automation.
final_outcome: stalled - closed as no-go for current fiscal year. Potential to re-open next procurement cycle if pricing or champion changes.
